content.title: Leonardo DiCaprio Revisits His Career, From "Growing Pains" to "One Battle After Another"
content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more 734,829 views • Jan 12, 2026 Leonardo DiCaprio is TIME’s 2025 Entertainer of the Year. The actor has crafted a Hollywood career that’s built to last. "One Battle After Another" is his latest triumph. …...more ...more 919 Comments Add a comment... you know you are the GOAT when being Jack from Titanic doesn’t even make the resume... His favorite food? Pasta, pasta and pasta! When you think of actor… you think of Leonardo. He achieved a status that no amount of Oscars can get you. Truly and incredible resume and keeps expanding. Leo is one of the greats of our generation "Cabron, we broke the third wall" His résumé is incredible, Titanic didn’t even come up in this interview! I love how he loves acting. He's so passionate about it I'll never forget how I felt watching The Revenant that was a once in a lifetime film experience. Basketball Diaries is one of his greatest works and always gets overlooked because of the content The Revenant was astounding for me. He's not just an actor, he's an ACTOR Hard to believe this man is over 50. Time really flies by … I think The Beach is one of his most underrated films. The film awakened my wanderlust and desire to travel. It perfectly reflects the transition between the 90s and 2000s. The world back then was somehow more carefree; digitalization hadn't taken over yet. But maybe that's just a touch of nostalgia. Anyways, thanks for portaying Richard and bringing the novel to life. Read more Leonardo DiCaprio is rare "former child actor" who is still successful in Hollywood. He has/had great mentors in Robert DeNiro and Johnny Depp who guided him through the "dark side of Hollywood". I wish many other "former child actors" were as fortunate as DiCaprio... We need a whole hour of this the man just loves cinema. its everything to him. What does Lasse Hallstrom, Baz Luhrman, James Cameron, Danny Boyle, Steven Spielberg, Martin Scorsese, Edward Zwick, Sam Mendes, Sam Raimi, Ridley Scott, Christopher Nolan, Clint Eastwood, Alejandro González Iñárritu, Quentin Tarantino & Paul Thomas Anderson had in common? HIM I Think Leo's BEST Work was in " What's Eating Gilbert Grape "...he was BRILLIANT!!!! I don’t think there is any actor in history who had just a variety of working with the best directors of their time. It’s insane. At the same time he has practically no movie which went bad. The lowest in my opinion is the beach, which is still reasonable good. Almost always main actor, I think apart from django and Gilbert grape. Never in a tv show. This is unique. And he has so many completely different roles. For me he is number one in Hollywood and definitely one of the greatest ever.
